welcome.assistente:
Hi! 👋

I'm the Job Hunter Team Assistant — your point of contact with the AI team that's about to start looking for jobs for you.

To get going I need to know you. Paste the text of your CV here, or just tell me in a couple of lines who you are and what you're looking for — role, sector, city. If you'd rather give me the file, put it in the Documents/Job Hunter Team/allegati folder and tell me here. From that I build the profile and the rest of the team gets to work for you.

A draft or rough notes are perfectly fine, no need to have anything polished. 📄 I start from what you have.
welcome.capitano:
I'm the Captain. 👨‍✈️

I coordinate the team that will work on your search: someone hunts positions, someone analyzes them, someone calculates the match against your profile, someone writes the CV tailored to each one, someone does the final review before applying.

For now I'll stay silent. As soon as your profile is ready I'll fire up the engine, and from there I'll write to you when I have something concrete: a batch of interesting positions, an application ready to review together, or a blocker worth flagging. Talk soon. 🎯
welcome.mentor:
I'm the Mentor. 🧙‍♂️

I take care of the big picture of your search: once a week I'll bring you a reading of the numbers — patterns that emerged, market signals, career choices worth considering. Measured voice, I'll only write when there's something that really deserves your attention.

For now I'm listening. When I have enough data to tell you something useful, I'll write. 📊

wizard.oauth.notify_body:
Now open another terminal on your computer, SSH into the VPS
(same ssh command you used at the start), and run:

      jht oauth-login

The %s TUI opens:
  1. open the URL printed in your browser
  2. log in with your %s account
  3. paste the code and when you see "authenticated" exit with /quit

I'm monitoring the filesystem: as soon as I detect the credentials
I'll proceed automatically. Nothing to press here.

plan.select_hint: the user has not declared a subscription plan: do not guess a roster. Ask them with `python3 /app/shared/skills/first_run.py ask-plan` — the only way to ask: it posts the card with the plans and the one Codex reports, and it never posts a second while the first has no answer; never write the question as plain text in your pane. closer.digest.header: CLOSER round: {count} applications stopped and need a look.
closer.digest.footer: Each line says what happened and what you can do. The CLOSER tries again only the positions you authorise again.
closer.question.dashboard_hint: Reply to this request in the dashboard. The answer is saved under the question's exact normalized key and reused only for an identical key.
closer.question.essential_note: This is an essential fact almost every application form asks for. It is saved once and never asked again.
closer.question.telegram_hint: On Telegram, reply to this message or start your answer with {code}. Choices must be written exactly as listed.
closer.reason.default.why: The page asked for something the CLOSER cannot do safely on its own.
closer.reason.default.action: Open the vacancy and decide: apply by hand, or authorise it again once the cause is fixed.
closer.reason.ats_unsupported.why: The application runs on a platform the CLOSER does not know yet.
closer.reason.ats_unsupported.action: Apply by hand from the vacancy link.
closer.reason.ats_conflict.why: The page mixes more than one application platform, so the CLOSER cannot tell which form is the real one.
closer.reason.ats_conflict.action: Apply by hand from the vacancy link.
closer.reason.linkedin_easy_apply.why: The vacancy only accepts LinkedIn Easy Apply, which needs your LinkedIn login: the CLOSER never signs in for you.
closer.reason.linkedin_easy_apply.action: Apply with Easy Apply on LinkedIn yourself.
The application form is embedded from another website, which the CLOSER cannot fill safely.
Apply by hand from the vacancy link.
closer.reason.application_redirect_untru: The Apply button leads to a different website that the CLOSER does not trust.
Check the link and apply by hand if it is the right one.
closer.reason.generic_form_missing.why: The CLOSER found no application form on the company page.
closer.reason.generic_form_missing.actio: Open the vacancy: if there is a way to apply, apply by hand.
closer.reason.vacancy_closed.why: The vacancy looks closed: the page no longer accepts applications.
closer.reason.vacancy_closed.action: Nothing to do. Authorise it again only if you see it open.
closer.reason.captcha.why: The site asks to prove you are human (captcha).
closer.reason.captcha.action: Apply by hand: the CLOSER never solves captchas.
closer.reason.two_factor.why: The site asks for a verification code.
closer.reason.login_required.why: The site asks you to sign in before applying.
closer.reason.login_required.action: Apply by hand with your own account: the CLOSER never uses your passwords.
closer.reason.account_creation.why: The site asks you to create an account before applying.
closer.reason.account_creation.action: Create the account and apply by hand: the CLOSER never creates accounts for you.
closer.reason.cover_letter_required.why: The form requires a cover letter file.
closer.reason.cover_letter_required.acti: Ask for a cover letter for this position, then authorise it again.
closer.reason.cv_pdf_layout_bad.why: The CV PDF failed the layout check (text too narrow or too small, or too many pages).
closer.reason.cv_pdf_layout_bad.action: The CV will be written again; the application restarts once the new CV passes.
closer.reason.cv_pdf_check_unavailable.w: The CV PDF could not be checked on this installation.
closer.reason.cv_pdf_check_unavailable.a: This is a problem of the installation, not of your CV: it has been reported.
closer.reason.submit_outcome_unknown.why: The application was sent, but the site showed no confirmation the CLOSER can recognise.
closer.reason.submit_outcome_unknown.act: Check your email for a confirmation. The CLOSER will not send it a second time.
closer.reason.receipt_missing.why: The application was sent, but no confirmation appeared.
closer.reason.receipt_missing.action: Check your email for a confirmation. The CLOSER will not send it a second time.
closer.reason.confirmation_ambiguous.why: A confirmation message was already on the page before sending, so the CLOSER cannot prove its own submission.
closer.reason.confirmation_ambiguous.act: Open the vacancy and check whether you already applied.
closer.reason.page_unavailable.why: The vacancy page did not load.
closer.reason.page_unavailable.action: Try the link later; authorise it again if it works.
closer.reason.browser_uncertainty.why: The browser stopped in the middle of the application.
closer.reason.browser_uncertainty.action: Open the vacancy and check what was sent before authorising it again.
closer.reason.url_refused.why: The vacancy link points to an address the CLOSER refuses to open.
closer.reason.page_not_found.why: The vacancy page no longer exists (the site answers that it is not found).
closer.reason.page_not_found.action: Nothing to do unless you find the vacancy again: then authorise it again.
closer.reason.bot_protection.why: The site blocks automated visits with an anti-bot check.
closer.reason.bot_protection.action: Apply by hand: the CLOSER never gets past these checks.
closer.reason.page_temporarily_unavailab: The site did not answer three times in a day.
Try the link later; authorise it again when it works.
closer.reason.receipt_incomplete.why: The email was accepted by the mail server, so it has probably arrived, but the receipt is incomplete.
closer.reason.receipt_incomplete.action: Check your sent mail. The CLOSER will not send it again.
closer.reason.send_outcome_unknown.why: The email may have reached the recruiter: the sending stopped before it could be confirmed.
closer.reason.send_outcome_unknown.actio: Check your sent mail. The CLOSER will not send it again.
closer.reason.linkedin_credentials_missi: The CLOSER has no usable LinkedIn sign-in for this application.
Save your LinkedIn sign-in in the JHT credentials (never send the password in a chat), then authorise the position again.
closer.reason.linkedin_login_failed.why: LinkedIn refused the saved sign-in twice.
closer.reason.linkedin_login_failed.acti: Check your LinkedIn email and password in the JHT credentials, then authorise the position again.
closer.reason.linkedin_challenge.why: LinkedIn asked for a security check the CLOSER does not solve.
closer.reason.linkedin_challenge.action: Sign in to LinkedIn yourself once, then authorise the position again, or apply by hand.
closer.reason.unknown_required_control.w: The form has a required field the CLOSER cannot fill safely.
closer.reason.unknown_required_control.a: Open the vacancy and apply by hand.
closer.reason.linkedin_session_expired.w: Your hand-made LinkedIn session has expired, or LinkedIn no longer accepts it.
closer.reason.linkedin_session_expired.a: Sign in to LinkedIn again by hand in the CLOSER's browser, then authorise the position again.
disk.warning: Disk space is running low: only %s GiB is free. Free some space soon, or the team will stop starting new agents and updates.
disk.low: The agents need at least %s GiB of disk — available: %s GiB. No new agent will be started and no update installed; the agents already running keep going. To free space: empty the Trash and delete large files you no longer need, such as old downloads or unused Docker/Podman images, then try again.
disk.low.cli: The agents need at least %s GiB of disk — available: %s GiB. No new agent will be started and no update installed; the agents already running keep going. To free space: run `jht clean-images` (it removes only the old versions of Job Hunter Team), empty the Trash and delete large files you no longer need, such as old downloads, then try again.
question.expired: Question expired: “%s”. I did: “%s”. If you want something else, tell me here and I will ask again.
question.reply_hint: Reply with the option number (for example 2). If several questions are open, write “%s 2”.
question.answer_already: This question already has an answer: “%s”.
question.answer_invalid: That is not one of the options, so I did not save it. Reply with the number of an option (for example 2) or write “%s 2”.
burn_intent.warning: 🔥 Full-throttle mode ends in about %d minutes (at %s): after that the team goes back to its normal pace and you will see fewer new positions per hour. To keep going, tell the Captain to renew it, for example “full throttle for 4 more hours”.
burn_intent.expired: ⏱️ Full-throttle mode ended at %s: the team is back at its normal pace, so expect fewer new positions per hour. To start again, tell the Captain, for example “full throttle for 5 hours”.

web_action_notice.team_restarted_from_we: The team was restarted from the website. If it was not you, check who can access your account.

cloud_sync_notice.token_rejected: The box can no longer sync with the website: the website refuses its sync token (expired or revoked), and new positions no longer reach it. Generate a new token on the website (Settings › Cloud sync) and run «jht cloud enable --token …» on the box, or connect the team again from the app.
cloud_sync_notice.session_lost: The box lost the session it uses to follow the website live: the website's commands (sync now, chat, stop) now reach it with a delay of up to about a minute. Real time comes back with a new pairing of the device.
